alt: A yellow diamond road warning sign in New South Wales whose arrows are so tangled and looping that the road layout it depicts is impossible to understand, with a baffled man pointing up at it
story: A road sign meant to warn drivers about an upcoming junction is drawn with so many tangled, looping arrows that it conveys nothing except confusion.
why_funny: The one job of a warning sign is to be understood at a glance — this one needs a warning sign of its own.
